reason: A DSH settings dashboard that aggregates local session logs into token, cost, duration, model, project, and task usage visualizations, with optional retrieval of current DeepSeek pricing.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH 设置中提供 Token 用量与费用统计面板，展示会话用量、时长、模型和项目排行，并支持获取 DeepSeek 定价。
summaries.en: Adds a DSH settings dashboard for token usage and cost estimates with session duration, model, project, and task statistics, plus optional DeepSeek pricing retrieval.

capabilities: Reads and aggregates local DSH session event logs
Displays token usage, estimated costs, durations, model rankings, project statistics, and task rankings
Provides local JSON API routes for dashboard data
Fetches DeepSeek public pricing when explicitly requested
